Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of G4008; unfinished, i.e. (by implication) interminable:--endless.
BiblicalUsage: Endless — Paul warning against endless genealogies, which minister questions rather than godly edifying in faith. The word is not about long lists; it is about lists that never arrive anywhere.
TheologicalSignificance: I take this as a rule for my own study: if it produces arguments instead of faith, it is a distraction.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
